description.zh: 要查询的防护对象组名称。您可以设置该参数，模糊查询已创建的防护对象组。
description.en: The name of the protected object group that you want to query. Fuzzy query is supported.

description.zh: 要查询的多个防护对象组。您可以设置该参数，查询多个已创建的防护对象组，多个防护对象组之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The names of the protected object groups that you want to query. Separate multiple names with commas (,).

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to view the current WAF instance ID.

description.zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为**1**，表示返回第 1 页数据。
description.en: The page number. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为**20**，表示每页包含 20 条结果。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: **20**, which indicates 20 entries per page.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-defense-resource-groups --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-wwo3600000i --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfmxc7lf0000eq --group-name-like demoGroupName --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --group-names groupName1,groupName2 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
